summary.name: WikiMatrix
summary.one_liner: WikiMatrix is a website for comparing features of different wiki software side by side in tables, to help choose a wiki package.
use_cases: Shortlisting wiki software for a team or project
Comparing features of several wikis side by side
Narrowing wiki options with a guided questionnaire
Finding wikis that have specific required features
summary.what_it_does:
The page is the front page of WikiMatrix, a tool for comparing wiki software. Users select wikis from a list, optionally narrow the list with a filter, and click compare to view a side-by-side feature table. A Choice Wizard asks a series of questions to suggest suitable wikis. A search lets users specify required features. A Consultant Marketplace links to wiki specialists for paid support. The page text does not list the specific wikis or features covered.</what_it_does>
<parameter name="pricing">unknown
notable: Side-by-side feature comparison tables for wiki software
Choice Wizard that narrows wikis through questions
Feature search to filter wikis by required features
caveats: The page text does not state the number of wikis covered or how often data is updated
Consultant marketplace services are implied to be paid but pricing is not stated
